title: Ex vivo radiation sensitivity assessment for individual head and neck cancer patients using deep learning-based automated nuclei and DNA damage foci detection.
summary: Deep learning plus image analysis segmented nuclei and 53BP1 foci in ex-vivo irradiated tissue from 21 patients; held-out foci counts correlated with manual references (R² 0.802).
